main_text.l: dam me iuste punire Vos Iudæos. Quæ malum! igitur hæc
vestra oscitantia, seu potius peruersitas, quod tantùm
de malo pœna dicitur [sicut & Amos.3. Non est malum in
ciuitate, quod Deus non fecit] id de malo culpæ exponere &
interpretari? Vos igitur infesto in Lutherum, Germanos,
& Anglos odio, tanquàm præcipiti turbine abreptos
fuisse; & in hoc, de Aquilone, Commento vestro, cùm
faceti videri vultis, ridiculos esse quis non videat?
Quin dic, obsecro, nunquamnè legisti vbi scriptum
est, {d}Ab Aquilone aurum? Hoc nisi Pontifices vestri ex-
perti olim fuissent, vbi miseros Germanos, & Anglos {e}Ex-

emunxissent, nunquam in doctrinam Lutheri tam imma-
niter sæuijssent. Denique quanto rectius Nobis in
vos telum vestrum retorquere liceat, nimirùm, [Omne
malum ab Aquilone] ait Propheta: vbi per Aquilonem Babylo-
nem significat: at Roma (omnium ferè Pontificiorum con-

page.notes: Running head is "De Authoritate, & Dignitate"; the chapter number "Cap.3." at the top right is a running head element and is not part of the title. The mark before "Quem-" at the bottom right appears to be a signature-like or note mark ("f"); it is not transcribed as text. The in-text mark after "Aquilonem" (c) is uncertain and is read as c. Italic extent in the Jeremiah and Chaldaean passages is read from the scan and may be imprecise at the edges.
